description: Mark your private messages up to seq as handled (monotonic: a lower seq changes nothing). This frees your inbox so others can keep writing to you.

room_credential.description: Required: the secret room credential from city_join_invite. It enters this chat and provider history; never post or share it. Lost it? Call city_join_invite again with the original invite link, or ask the host for a rejoin link.

seq.description: Marks every private message up to this inbox seq as handled.
